2123228403889275058.en_summary: InvestmentGuru_: Fed Governor Waller said today he favors a 50 basis point move in December. The minutes say a couple of officials are open to more than 25. The market prices 5% on a half point.
2123228403889275058.zh_summary: InvestmentGuru_：聯準會理事 Waller 今天表示他支持 12 月加息 50 個基點。會議紀錄顯示少數官員對超過 25 個基點持開放態度。市場對半點加息的定價為 5%。

2123226623088738567.en_summary: First Squawk: BOJ Governor Ueda stresses the need to scrutinise how higher borrowing costs may influence business and household spending.

2123226592151519533.en_summary: First Squawk: BOJ Governor Ueda notes that accommodative financial conditions continue to support economic growth.

2123226562330087578.zh_summary: First Squawk：日本央行總裁植田和男承認加息會增加企業融資成本，但表示企業盈利與工資增長也很重要。
